title: 第20章 卑鄙的易肥
content_zh:
爆！爆！爆！

    国内的舆情还在爆炸，电影票房也水涨船高。

    曹郁不停地和谷川打电话，国内有点什么动静，都通知他一下。

    他也更期待和谷川的下一步电影了。

    范小胖那边，和谷川的联系也殷勤了起来，说话的时候，会不自觉地夹着点嗓子，对新电影格外的期待。

    而且她还说增肥已经有了效果，问什么时候进组。

    连小刘都和谷川打了一个电话。

    可是别人都是恭喜甚至恭维他，小刘居然找他要钱。

    说‘电影这么成功，你应该可以还钱了吧？’这种伤人的话。

    你眼里只有我骗你的那6315美元吗？

    谷川说道：“易肥，现在知道我的厉害了吧？我劝你还是不要找我要账了，那6315美元就当是介绍费，让你来参演我的电影怎么样？

    不过女主已经没有了，女儿还是可以的。”

    由于你有眼不识泰山，好好的女主变成了女儿，影后也飞走了。

    “不不不，我还是要钱吧。”刘艺菲小声说道。

    她当初被谷川骗钱之后，害怕被骂笨蛋，和她妈说借钱给朋友了。

    要是这钱要不回来，岂不是要露馅。

    而且谷川的电影也不是什么好项目啊。

    虽然现在这部电影正在疯狂赚钱，但口碑太烂了，陆穿都被骂死了。

    连刘晔和刘若瑛，也没少挨骂，纯纯负面影响更大啊。

    高强度冲浪的刘艺菲，看着那些骂人的评论都害怕。

    让我给谷川演女主？

    疯了吧，她才不要。

    “你油盐不进！”谷川恨铁不成钢地说道：“你肯定会后悔的。”

    刘艺菲不吭声。

    她最后悔的事情，就是信了你的鬼话，被骗了6315美元。

    刘艺菲说道：“你到底什么时候还我那6315美元。”

    “不对。”谷川皱着眉说道：“我已经还过你八十了。”

    卑鄙的小刘，居然想骗我八十块。

    这人怎么这么坏啊。

    刘艺菲也想起了刚抓到谷川的时候，从他兜里翻出来的几张皱巴巴的钞票，以及谷川的病历单。

    她突然有些不好意思。
content_en:
burst! burst! burst!

    Domestic public opinion is still exploding, and the movie box office is also rising.

    Cao Yu kept calling Gu Chuan, informing him of any news in the country.

    He is also looking forward to Tanigawa's next film.

    Fan Xiaopang also became more attentive in his contact with Gu Chuan. When he spoke, he would unconsciously raise his voice, looking forward to the new movie.

    Moreover, she also said that the weight gain has been effective and asked when she would join the group.

    Even Xiao Liu made a phone call with Gu Chuan.

    But while others congratulated and even complimented him, Xiao Liu actually asked him for money.

    Say, ‘The movie is so successful, you should be able to pay back the money, right? ’ Such hurtful words.

    Do you only see the $6,315 I defrauded you of?

    Tanichuan said: "Yi Fei, now you know how good I am, right? I advise you not to ask me for payment. Just treat the $6,315 as an introduction fee. How about letting you participate in my movie?"

    But the heroine is gone, but the daughter is still okay. "

    Because you have blind eyes, the good heroine turned into a daughter, and the movie queen also flew away.

    "No, no, no, I still want money." Liu Yifei said in a low voice.

    After she was defrauded by Tanichuan, she was afraid of being called a fool, so she told her mother that she had lent the money to a friend.

    If the money is not returned, the secret will be exposed.

    And Tanigawa’s movie is not a good project.

    Although this movie is making crazy money now, its reputation is so bad that Lu Chuan was scolded to death.

    Even Liu Ye and Liu Ruoying were scolded, and Chun Chun had a greater negative impact.

    Liu Yifei, who surfs hard, is scared when she sees those abusive comments.

    Want me to play the heroine for Tanichuan?

    Crazy, she doesn't want it.

    "You can't get enough of it!" Tanichuan said with hatred, "You will definitely regret it."

    Liu Yifei remained silent.

    The thing she regrets most is that she believed your lies and was defrauded of $6,315.

    Liu Yifei said: "When will you pay me back the $6,315?"

    "That's not right." Tanichuan frowned and said, "I've already paid you eighty points."

    Despicable Xiao Liu, you actually tried to defraud me of eighty yuan.

    Why is this person so bad?

    Liu Yifei also recalled the few crumpled bills she took out of Tanichuan's pocket when she first caught him, as well as Tanichuan's medical records.

    She suddenly felt embarrassed.
